subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` make OpenAI-compatible requests tolerate a generic body `model`, despite the current documented agent-first model contract?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but it changes a public Gateway API contract and needs a parity decision across Chat Completions, Responses, and embeddings before automation can safely choose behavior.

options.title: Adopt Header Precedence
options.body: Treat the body `model` as client compatibility metadata whenever a valid agent header selects the agent, and update shared resolver behavior plus docs/tests for the selected endpoints.

options.title: Preserve Agent-First Contract
options.body: Continue requiring body `model` to be `openclaw`, `openclaw/default`, or `openclaw/<agentId>`, and document SDK integrations around those values plus optional `x-openclaw-model`.

options.title: Limit To Chat Completions
options.body: Make `/v1/chat/completions` tolerant for SDK compatibility while intentionally leaving Responses and embeddings on the stricter agent-target model contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt Header Precedence
recommendation.body: Treat the body `model` as client compatibility metadata whenever a valid agent header selects the agent, and update shared resolver behavior plus docs/tests for the selected endpoints.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision changes the agent-first model contract that `vincentkoc` introduced and extended across the OpenAI-compatible Gateway surface.
